ck: (36)pavapratipa: evan kenacicankitananunanacatustayan nirakrtyaparena sankitananatnapetasatakananunanatvayanapi nirakartunanuvatati yacetanucyata iti atra katavatityanantaraniti saptotyaharya apasitantasceti parenapi kataternityatvasityE paricinatvankikarena vyavaharikavinasankikaratiti pava katatyartakriyeti nutkaratipraharanantaranapi tena katena calaharanatyartakriyakaranarupatosascetyarta apatiscasO tosasceti tosapatiriti viparitasanasa tateveti katanasakala evetyarta na kakanavityatityatipatena stanpatisankraha cakatapetavate katasya patenEva kakanatinapyapetatatEva vinasa sanpavita iti vikalpopapati uta netiti vaktavyanityanuvartate katatyartakriyapava iti tesan kakanatinan yartakriyavakasatanatirupa tatapava prasacyetetyarta kakanavityayornasayokaceti kakanasya vyavaharikanityatvenavityaya cnanEkanivartyatvena nutkarapraharatina katanasakale tayorvinaso na yucyata iti pava tayorvyapakatvena nasayokatityapyahu tatrsayorapi kakanavityayoritaresan cetanineva nasankikare kin patakanityata aha — nahapralayanoksO syataniti tatEvetyanuvartate tata ca yati katanasakale sarvavinasa syatarhitanineva nahapralaya syat avityavinase cetanineva noksopi syatityarta tvitiya iti katanasepi kakanatinananasascetityarta kataniti nastanastayo paranartikapetayokatiti pava tatevopapatayati — na hiti paranartikapeta iti nastaracateneti sesa atra sarvasyapi vyavaharikaprapancasya vipratipativisayataya nastanastakatapatayornitarsayitunasakyatvatpratipasikavyavaharike racatasukti eva nitarsayati na hi vyavaharikayorkatapatayoriva
